description: Confirmed roster moves as published by the promotion (UFC today), newest first: signed, left (no longer listed on the roster), retired and returned, each with the fighter, the previous and new status, and the window it happened in (between previous_checked_at and observed_at). Filter by since / until, kind or fighter. Cursor paginated. Pro plans and up.

fighter.description: Only this fighter's moves: slug (preferred) or numeric id.

org.description: A promotion that publishes its roster ("ufc").

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD (UTC) or ISO datetime: moves observed on or after it.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD (UTC, the whole day) or ISO datetime: moves observed on or before it.

name: get_roster_moves
title: Get roster moves (signings, departures, retirements)
